instruction: Candid documentary photograph of a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio. On the left, the blonde girl (R3) in a beige long-sleeve top, shorts, and white socks performs a deep side lunge to the right with hands on her knee. In the center, the dark-haired girl (R1) in a matching beige outfit and white socks lunges in unison, hands on her hips. Both look forward with focused expressions. On the far right, the legs of a partially visible bystander in beige shorts are cropped. Soft, diffused natural light fills the space, creating a clean, neutral color palette.
